title: The Chess Master's Acknowledgment
next_chapter_hook: As the phantom of Cang Yutian was about to dissipate, he left behind one final words—"Beyond the chess game you perceive, someone still watches you."

text.content: The voice did not come from the void, but exploded directly within his Mental Sea, like a colossal beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years finally opening its eyes. Chen Ji felt his soul encompassed by a vast, boundless consciousness—this was a presence surpassing all his previous understanding—warmer than the cold scrutiny of the Heavenly Eye, yet heavier than any mortal emotion.

dialogue.content: "Of those who can hear my voice, over a thousand years, you are the second." The voice carried a peculiar sense of satisfaction, "The first was the one who personally handed you the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the tremors in his soul. His sister's cries still echoed in his ears, but at this moment he had to focus on dealing with this sudden turn of events. He knew that what he faced now was no longer the cold Heavenly Eye that merely manipulated fate's chess pieces, but the Chess Player who had been scheming in history's shadows for ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: "Junior has one question." Chen Ji's voice reverberated through his Mental Sea. He neither bowed, nor showed fear, nor displayed any passive demeanor, "What is the relationship between the Heavenly Eye and the Chess Player?"

A low laugh rang out from the void, carrying a complex emotion that intertwined bitterness with relief. "Good, good, good!" Three consecutive affirmatives, "For ten thousand years, finally someone dares to question me directly."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly. He noticed Cang Yutian had said "question" rather than "inquire." This subtle difference in wording set off alarm bells in his heart—the other party had admitted there were secrets that could not be revealed.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye is the rule." Cang Yutian's voice became solemn, "And the Chess Player is the executor of the rule—but also the prisoner of the rule." He paused, "Do you think I have spent ten thousand years only existing as a remnant soul dwelling on the first page of the Tianji Record?"

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the Chess Player Cang Yutian's first-ever candid revelation of secrets?

choices.text: Listening to the Chess Player's Guidance
choices.description: Since the other party took the initiative to be candid, why not hear what this ten-thousand-year-old existence has to say? Perhaps he could obtain crucial information about his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts.
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Partial Truths from the Chess Player
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's guidance may hide traps
choices.process_label: 陈机选择了暂时隐忍，以退为进

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak immediately but slowly closed his eyes. He knew Cang Yutian could perceive all his emotions, so he deliberately maintained an almost ethereal calmness in his soul. "Please enlighten me, Senior." His voice carried no emotional fluctuations, yet perfectly expressed his desire for information itself.

dialogue.content: "Good." A hint of satisfaction flowed through Cang Yutian's tone, "You are more like him than I imagined. Then let me ask you—do you know what is required to activate the true complete form of the Tianji Record?"

choices.description: His first candid revelation after ten thousand years of scheming must have ulterior motives. Chen Ji would not easily believe that an existence controlling fate would help him for no reason.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may withdraw his trust because of this
choices.process_label: 陈机决定先发制人，试探深浅

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the smile tracing a mocking arc within his Mental Sea. "Senior schemed the world ten thousand years ago, and now actively appears to share your wisdom—junior ventures to ask, what is the price of such 'grace'?"

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian fell silent for an instant, then burst into a hearty laugh. "Hahaha! What a Chen Ji! What meticulous calculations!" The laughter stopped abruptly, "You ask well. I have been waiting for precisely these words."

choices.text: Reverse Control of the Game within the Game
choices.description: Since the other party appeared as a 'respectable opponent,' Chen Ji decided to take the initiative and draw Cang Yutian into his own rhythm.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of spiritual power
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by Cang Yutian's intentions
choices.process_label: 陈机准备将对方拉入自己的棋局

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely gently raised his right hand. In that instant, the incomplete page of the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea emitted a faint glow—the primordial power he had never actively invoked before. Cang Yutian's aura instantly froze.

dialogue.content: "You—!" An unprecedented fluctuation appeared in Cang Yutian's voice, "You can actually actively draw out the Tianji Record's source? Impossible! This is something not even I can accomplish!"

text.content: Chen Ji sensed the incomplete page of the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea undergoing subtle changes. The originally blurry patterns had become extraordinarily clear, as if something was awakening from slumber. He knew this was a chain reaction triggered by Cang Yutian's appearance.

dialogue.content: "Since you ask, I shall tell you." Cang Yutian's tone became unprecedentedly serious, "The Heavenly Eye is the chessboard—it only places pieces, captures pieces, and judges victory or defeat. The Chess Player, however, is the awakener of the pieces—but the price of awakening is becoming part of an even larger chess game."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He finally understood—the relationship between the Heavenly Eye and Cang Yutian was far more complex than he imagined. One was the embodiment of rules, the other a rebel attempting to break those rules. This imbalance precisely explained why Cang Yutian could only exist as a remnant soul.

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, I attempted to break this deadlocked game." Cang Yutian's voice carried endless exhaustion, "I failed. The Heavenly Eye did not kill me, but imprisoned me on the first page of the Tianji Record—as warning, as deterrent." He paused, "The fragment in your hands is the only spark I left for this world."

choice.prompt: The conditions for the final choice across three ending paths are presented completely for the first time. How should Chen Ji choose his path?

choices.description: Completely destroy the Heavenly Eye and break the fate chess game. This path requires Chen Ji to sacrifice the complete power of the Tianji Record. The success rate is extremely low, but if successful, it will fundamentally change the operating rules of the Three Realms.
choices.visible_reward: Completely rewrite the rules of fate
choices.risk_hint: Success rate less than thirty percent, and requires sacrificing the Heavenly Fate of all close ones
choices.process_label: 陈机开始推演超脱之路的可能性

text.content: A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He thought of his sister Chen Nian's cries, of those he had schemed against, of the ambitions and resentment he had hidden beneath his废物persona. If this path could protect everyone he wanted to protect, could grant his sister true freedom—

dialogue.content: "Are you certain?" A tremor appeared in Cang Yutian's voice, "The price of this path is far greater than you can imagine. I—precisely because I walked this path, met my current fate."

choices.description: Join forces with the Chess Player to gradually seize control within the Heavenly Eye's rules. This path is the most stable, but it means Chen Ji must inherit Cang Yutian's will and become the new "Chess Player."
choices.visible_cost: Bear ten thousand years of karma
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Chess Player's complete inheritance
choices.process_label: 陈机开始权衡共谋之利的得失

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while. If he chose this path, he would become Cang Yutian's successor, bearing the mission of opposing the Heavenly Eye. But at the same time, he could obtain sufficient power to find his sister and protect those he wished to protect.

dialogue.content: "I will not force you." Cang Yutian's voice softened, "But I must tell you—the Path of Conspiracy is not compromise, but seeking the possibility of breaking the局within the rules. I waited ten thousand years, finally encountering someone who might actually succeed."

choices.description: Refuse the Chess Player's invitation and attach oneself to no chess game. Chen Ji will walk a completely self-determined path—neither destroying the Heavenly Eye nor opposing it, but establishing a brand new order.
choices.risk_hint: Will simultaneously face dual pressure from both the Heavenly Eye and the Chess Player
choices.process_label: 陈机决定开辟全新的第三种可能

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, a smile carrying a boldness and confidence Cang Yutian had never witnessed. "Senior, I have a question." He raised his head, his gaze seemingly穿透the Mental Sea's limitations, staring directly at that lofty existence, "Why must I choose one of the paths you present?"

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian was stunned. For ten thousand years, countless geniuses and heroes had bowed before him or met heroic deaths, yet no one had ever dared speak to him in such a tone. But immediately, he let out the most畅快大笑of the day. "Hahaha! Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!"

text.content: Chen Ji waited quietly for Cang Yutian's response. He knew how arrogant his words had been—a mere ant who had not even broken through to Golden Core, daring to question the authority of a ten-thousand-year Chess Player. But he also understood—it was precisely this attitude that could make the other party truly regard him as an opponent, rather than a piece to be casually manipulated.

dialogue.content: "Do you know, Chen Ji?" Cang Yutian's voice carried an indescribable复杂的感慨, "Ten thousand years ago, I was also as arrogant as you. But I ultimately failed, because I did not find a path truly my own." He paused, "And you—perhaps truly able to walk a path I never imagined."

text.content: Chen Ji caught the recognition in Cang Yutian's words. His heart raced slightly—this was not merely the Chess Player's affirmation of his strength, but recognition of his brand new path. This meant starting today, he would no longer anyone's piece, but a true candidate for Chess Player.

dialogue.content: "Since you possess such ambition, I shall give you a great gift." Cang Yutian's voice became solemn, "Regarding your sister's whereabouts—she is in the deepest part of the '彼岸Forbidden Land,' sealed within the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' That place is beyond even the Heavenly Eye's ability to窥探, and was also the retreat I chose after my failure."

choice.prompt: After learning his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Since he knew his sister's exact location, Chen Ji refused to wait another moment. He would go to the彼岸Forbidden Land immediately, even though danger lurked everywhere.

choices.risk_hint: The danger level of the彼岸Forbidden Land far exceeds imagination

text.content: An unprecedented light blazed in Chen Ji's eyes. Ten years! A full ten years, he had walked the world under his废物persona, scheming against heroes, doing everything for this very moment. Sister, wait for me!

choices.description: Since the彼岸Forbidden Land is beyond even the Heavenly Eye's窥探, it must be extremely dangerous. Chen Ji decided to gather more intelligence and prepare thoroughly before taking action.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He knew—the more intense such moments, the more he could not act rashly. Ten years of scheming had taught him—one careless move, and not only could he not save his sister, but he would drag himself down as well.

choices.description: Since Cang Yutian proactively revealed his sister's whereabouts, it showed he was willing to help Chen Ji. Chen Ji decided to seize this opportunity to争取more support.

choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's help must have its own purpose

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, but there was no humility in his posture. "Since Senior informed junior of this matter, presumably you already intend to assist. Junior ventures to ask—would Senior be willing to grant some convenience?"

Within the Mental Sea, that ancient phantom gazed at the young cultivator before him. For ten thousand years, he had witnessed countless geniuses' falls, many heroes' defeats, but never had he seen someone like Chen Ji—明明weak as an ant, yet possessing the courage to stare directly at the heavens;满腹with scheming, yet never losing the steadfastness of his heart.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Cang Yutian suddenly spoke, his voice carrying an unprecedented solemnity, "I waited ten thousand years, finally encountering a truly worthy opponent. No matter which path you ultimately choose, I will wait for you at the彼岸."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at that phantom. His eyes held no fear, no gratitude, only an almost ruthless determination. "Senior, rest assured—junior will not disappoint you." He paused, "After all—being acknowledged as an opponent by the Chess Player is itself a kind of honor."

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian let out a low laugh, containing relief, anticipation, and a trace of barely perceptible envy. "Good, very good." His form began to gradually fade, "I will prepare a gift for you at the彼岸—as for what it is, wait until you come to personally claim it."

text.content: When the Mental Sea returned to tranquility, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The surrounding scenery remained unchanged, yet his state of mind had undergone a heaven-earth transformation.
